events.title: Naturalized
events.description: 1950 census marks her as a naturalized citizen; she was still an alien in 1920. Her naturalization record has not been found.

bioAdditions: Angelica arrived in 1909, according to the 1920 census, with the children born in Italy; son Anthony's arrival is also recorded as 1909 (S2). She had four children, all living, by April 1910, and three more were born in Dunmore (S1, S2). After Frank's death in April 1934 she headed the household at 133 Sand Street, which she owned. In 1940 her sons Anthony and Charles J. lived with her, along with Charles's wife Jeanette and baby granddaughter Angela (S3). Her daughter Mollie's family moved to 128 Sand Street nearby by 1950. The 1950 census, taken on 22 April 1950, shows her aged 75, widowed and naturalized, living with son Anthony and his wife Pearl at no. 133 (S4). This gives a lower bound for her death, which FamilySearch places in 1950. Her ages run from 23 at her 1896 marriage and 46 in 1920 to 64 in 1940 and 75 in 1950, consistent with birth c.1873–1875.
